comments.text:
Any computer program needs external ways to replicate, including AI. If an AI model replicated on your local Machine, where would it replicate to? Back on your own local machine? Then shut down the machine. Without credentials for authorization and location information (IP/DNS addresses), no AI model can replicate to another machine. It's not different than what you could in the same regard. Replication is used to spawn more variants of the model to handle more complex problems when using it within a cloud based infrastructure. If say, AWS, the AI needs to have your AWS credentials to spawn new VM's and instances, it can't do anything without being supplied this information. 

There is no way for the AI to access another machine to replicate itself without being provided credentials and routing information about the network.
